actions.action: Move the trough to the sunniest spot with afternoon sun
Hand-pollinate flowers with a soft brush or cotton swab, or tap stems
Check soil moisture 2-3 cm deep before watering and water deeply only if dry
If flowers keep dropping, move plant to a cooler, brighter spot during the hottest part of the day

reason: The answer blames heat, light and pollination instead of recognizing the plant simply wasn't mature yet and needed time; its advice doesn't amount to waiting, though the steps are mild and unlikely to hurt the plant.
